description:
Use this when you need Singapore national public-holiday status for 2026-2027. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need an employer roster, a non-Sunday weekly rest day, bank/exchange closures, or a year outside the pinned MOM coverage.
What it computes: Checks a Singapore date using Ministry of Manpower national public holidays and explicitly published observed dates, with a separate employer-rest-day limitation.
Example user requests: Is 2027-02-08 a Singapore working day after Chinese New Year? | Check the Singapore public-holiday status of 2026-08-10.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2027-02-08"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_observed, weekend_days, rest_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, source_quality, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = CLDR weekday baseline and no MOM public-holiday event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/singapore-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/singapore-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in the pinned MOM 2026-2027 coverage.

name: check_singapore_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Singapore national public holidays plus the CLDR Saturday/Sunday baseline.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or MOM public holiday.

holiday_names.description: MOM holiday names applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when the source explicitly publishes an observed date.

is_working_day.description: True when the CLDR Saturday/Sunday baseline is a weekday and no included MOM public holiday applies.

rest_day_policy.description: Employer-specific weekly rest-day placement is not inferred.

source_quality.description: Official Singapore government sources, with employer-rest-day limitation.

sources.description: Official MOM, government open-data and legislation sources.

weekend_days.description: CLDR weekend convention used only as the baseline.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Singapore Official Public-Holiday Working Day
